Matematika: kasrlar testi
Fan: Matematika
Sinf: 5-sinf
Qiyinlik: O'rta
Vaqt: 25 daqiqa
O'tish bali: 70%

1. 1/2 + 1/4 nechaga teng? (2 ball)
A) 3/4
B) 2/6
C) 1/6
D) 1/8
Javob: A
Izoh: Maxrajni 4 ga keltiramiz: 2/4 + 1/4 = 3/4.

2. 2/3 ning 9 dan qismi nechaga teng?
A. 3
B. 6
C. 9
D. 12
To'g'ri javob: B

Savol 3: Qaysi kasr eng katta?
A) 1/3  B) 1/2  C) 3/4  D) 2/5
Javob: C
Tushuntirish: 3/4 = 0,75 — eng katta qiymat.

4) 5/10 kasrni qisqartiring
*A) 1/5
B) 1/2
C) 2/5
D) 5/2
